hunks.baseline: And amid the silence and shock that swallowed everyone, thousands of eyes finally settled on the figure who had appeared.

hunks.baseline: A reality he couldn’t believe or understand.

hunks.baseline: The man’s hand trembled around the hilt of his sword. A groan slipped through his clenched teeth.

hunks.sol: His wavering voice cut off.

hunks.baseline: The immense killing intent and aura he unleashed swallowed up the space around him.

hunks.baseline: Simply by existing, he was already in contact with death.

hunks.baseline: The aura the man brought forth was no different.

hunks.baseline: *At most, half as strong as that guy.*
hunks.sol: *Half as strong as that guy, if I’m generous.*

hunks.baseline: Thinking of *that guy*, shimmering in the distance like a mirage, the Skeleton King let out a quiet snort.
hunks.sol: Thinking of *that guy*, shimmering in the distance like a mirage, the Skeleton King let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: The world called monsters like him monsters, but the real monster was someone else.
hunks.sol: The world called beings like him monsters. But the real monster was someone else.

hunks.baseline: “Why did you have to do something like this? If you’d stayed quietly tucked away in some corner of the desert, you wouldn’t have made that guy angry.”
hunks.sol: “Why did you have to do all this? If you’d stayed tucked away in some corner of the desert, you wouldn’t have made him angry.”

hunks.baseline: “……God, God chose us. The great God Himself sent the Prophet to lead His warriors to the promised land!”
hunks.sol: “……God chose us. God Himself chose us! He sent the Prophet to lead His warriors to the promised land!”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King glanced around as he echoed the words.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King looked around.

hunks.baseline: Corpses littered the ground in every direction.
hunks.sol: Corpses lay in every direction.

hunks.baseline: “Is this the promised land you’ve been blathering on about all this time?”
hunks.sol: “Surely this isn’t the promised land you’ve been blathering on about.”

hunks.baseline: “If you mean you promised God that you’d all die here together, then sure, I’ll give you that one.”
hunks.sol: “Unless you promised God you’d all die here together. In that case, I’ll give you that one.”

hunks.baseline: Far enough to reach the ears of every Hunter and fanatic.

hunks.sol: Countless faces he had encountered since coming into the world flashed before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: His bewildered gaze passed over the countless faces surrounding him.

hunks.baseline: And it wasn’t just the Hunters.

hunks.baseline: He wanted to shout at the people wavering before him.

hunks.baseline: Tell them not to be taken in by a demon’s silver tongue.
hunks.sol: Tell them not to fall for a demon’s words.

hunks.baseline: In his whitened mind, all that repeated was the demon’s whisper from a moment ago.
hunks.sol: In his mind, gone blank, the demon’s words from a moment ago repeated without end.

hunks.baseline: The sticky pools of blood gathered at his feet.
